$comment: Machine-readable record of the upstream spec files this codebase conforms to.
Each entry is the commit SHA that last touched that file at the time we conformed to it.
When drift is detected: re-read the changed file, update this pin in the
same PR, and re-run conformance. Drift, not inability, is the failure mode.
$methodologyNote: These SHAs come from a FULL-HISTORY clone. An earlier pass used `git clone --depth 50`, where
`git log -1 -- <path>` falsely attributes files to the shallow boundary commit: five specs were
pinned to 60af28e (an examples-only commit that touches no spec at all). Always resolve per-file
SHAs against full history — never a shallow clone.
